name: TC-08-work-order-activity
description: TC-08.1: Work Order Activity — Full activity lifecycle management

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — Work Order Activity List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order Activity. Activities are individual tasks within a work order that can be assigned to different technicians and tracked independently.

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — Activity List Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The activity list shows all work order activities with their status, assigned worker, and parent work order. Activities progress through: Awaiting Resources → Ready → In Progress → On Hold → Complete → Closed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — New Activity
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a work order activity. Link it to a parent work order, assign a worker, and specify the task description.

steps.target: input[name='description'], textarea[name='description'], input[name='activity_description'], textarea[name='activity_description'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name']

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — Fill Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Bearing replacement — Motor Assembly" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — Activity Created
doc_metadata.caption: The activity is created in 'Awaiting Resources' state. Allocate resources to move it to 'Ready', then start work to move to 'In Progress'.

doc_metadata.title: TC-08.1 — Activity Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The activity detail page shows the task description, assigned worker, parent work order, estimated hours, and workflow state. Use the workflow dropdown to progress the activity through its lifecycle.
